about.label: About us
about.intro: We’re a team of curious engineers using AI to accelerate how ideas become real. Based in Mongolia, we build practical tools that help organizations make better decisions and work more efficiently. We’re driven by curiosity, experimentation, and the belief that meaningful innovation comes from building, testing, and learning fast.

vision.title: Intelligent Data
vision.description: Transforming complex information into meaningful intelligence.

vision.title: Advanced Technology
vision.description: Building practical AI systems for real-world challenges.

intelligence.name: PORTAL system
intelligence.title: PORTAL system
intelligence.description: is a system that connects open and large-scale data within a clear legal framework, then uses AI to process and refine it into information people can actually use. The goal is simple: make data more accessible, accurate, and reliable for everyday decisions.

map.name: SURVEY system
map.title: SURVEY system
map.description: uses AI to move beyond superficial polling and bring more citizens’ voices into real decisions. It turns public responses into structured, quantitative data that policymakers and businesses can actually use.

analytics.name: virtual assistant
analytics.title: virtual assistant
analytics.description: is an AI-powered software agent trained on an organization’s internal data. It can answer questions, prepare reports and summaries, raise alerts, and trigger automated actions to support day-to-day work.
